title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
llm_summary: OpenAI is said to have secured an extra $11 billion in a new funding round that’s still being finalized, pushing its post‑money valuation to roughly $1.25 trillion. The influx of capital, coming from existing and possibly new investors, underscores the market’s confidence in OpenAI’s AI leadership and its expanding suite of products. The round is expected to close in the coming weeks.
